value.Name: The Moonstone Twin (level 45)
value.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-13 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Brigit will send you to Maudalin who lives at the top of the tower on the road to Caille. He tells you to seek the Tree Fairie near the edge of Bri Leith and Cursed Forest (16k/20k) who says you must kill Cadoc who runs with his enchanted horses during the day and night along the river from end to end. The horses are neutral and there are two sets: dark steeds at night and veil steeds during the day. Kill both sets and Cadoc will appear. Kill him and he gives you the second half-moonstone. Return this to Brigit for the second reward which is an Enchanter's Jewel.
Cadoc is on west side of river at far south end.

I did this with my bard and killed both day and night steeds, which worked fine (if in a grp). With my champ at lvl 45 I noticed in the journal that you first have to do the day steeds and the text says to leave them alone, just follow. I solo folowed them to the end of the river where I just talked to a friendly Cadoc. This got me the day step. The night step I'm afraid is a violent one...

value.Name: The Moonstone Twin (level 47)
value.Source: Allakhazam quest page as archived 2004-10-28 (Wayback Machine)
Lines: Next Brigit sends you to kill a banshee named Rioldna who roams in the water northwest of Alainn Binn. After you kill her and get the first stone, the Faerie Queen appears momentarily and sends you to the healer in Alainn Binn (Ceri), who says you must kill the Faerie Queen in Cursed Forest (night only, east side of the river at 50k/25k). Kill the three maidens to get the Queen to spawn. Kill her maidens first, then kill her to get the second stone. Before she dies, she sends you to free the steed that is being held captive by the far dorochas.
To Find Banshee Rioldna, head to Alainn Binn in far South-East corner of Bog of Cullen and go West-SouthWest to /loc= 44200,52400
I believe it is a night time only spawn. Mentioned in another posting is midnight - 6:00am, I found her at 2:30am
Once you see the apparition of the Faerie Queen, head back into Alainn Binn the north hut and see the healer Ceri.
Target Healer Ceri and type "/say Apparition" and then "/say Faerie Queen".

entries.source: Allakhazam quest page 341 'The Moonstone Twin (level 47)', archived 2004-10-28 (Wayback Machine), period-data/archive/wayback-allakhazam/quest_pages.jsonl.gz

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepType = '0' || substr(StepType, 2), TargetName = replace(TargetName, 'merucha;224|', 'merucha;200|'), StepText = replace(StepText, 'Speak with Merucha.|', 'Kill a merucha near the Treibh Caillte entrance for its water dye.|'), SourceText = replace(SourceText, 'Speak with Merucha.|', 'Kill a merucha near the Treibh Caillte entrance for its water dye.|') WHERE ID = 20907 AND StepType LIKE '4|%'
entries.why: step 1 was an Interact with the hostile level 40-45 meruchas inside Treibh Caillte (region 224); period: 'First is the water dye from merucha's. They spawn near the Treibh Cali dungeon NW of innis village' (12 meruchas stand outside in region 200)
step 1 marker moved from inside the dungeon to the meruchas by the Treibh Caillte entrance (Lough Gur 12k,32k)

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(replace(StepText, 'Give Duana or Edan the collar so you can talk to them.', 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to her and Edan.'), 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to him and Edan.', 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to her and Edan.'), SourceText = replace(replace(SourceText, 'Give Duana or Edan the collar so you can talk to them.', 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to her and Edan.'), 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to him and Edan.', 'Give Duana the collar so you can talk to her and Edan.') WHERE ID BETWEEN 20781 AND 20784
entries.why: the step is a Deliver to Duana;200 (a DataQuest step has one target), so 'Duana or Edan' sent players to Edan for nothing; the period walkthrough's easiest route is Duana ('Easiest way to find Duana is to head to Parth Farm'); Duana is a she in the period text ('I gave the collar to Duana, but she told me', Maeve: 'Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment')
Cad Goddeau C and D rows for class 58 only (Vampiir, Catacombs): no 1.65 character can be offered them

Misdelivered Letter rows for advanced classes at levels 1-4: True 1.65 characters stay base class until level 5, so these can never be offered; the base-class rows 20800, 20801, 20803, 20805, 20808 stay

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, 'Chieftess Niamh asks you to watch the rat-catcher do his job at dusk.|', 'Chieftess Niamh tells you about the rat-catcher she hired to lead the rats into the lake at dusk; speak with her again.|') WHERE ID = 20903
entries.why: the period dusk event (the rat trail walking into the lake about 6pm) is not simulated and the step completes on a plain Interact with Chieftess Niamh, so the journal no longer asks the player to watch for it
